title: Brazil's blueprint for cyber resilience (Web Summit LIS26 session page)
what_it_says: Web Summit's session page: 'Brazil's blueprint for cyber resilience', November 11, 2026, 14:32 to 14:40 (Lisbon time), Stage 7, track Corporate Innovation Summit. Description: Cyber threats are redefining national security. When every critical service relies on cloud infrastructure, how can nations ensure control without retreating into digital isolation? Drawing on Brazil’s real-world rollout of sovereign cloud
